summary.text: Daniel R. Vollmer is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 6 (Willow City) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Daniel R. Vollmer's service as "House since 2025". The member page lists Daniel R. Vollmer's committee assignments as including the Agriculture and the Industry, Business and Labor standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Daniel R. Vollmer's occupation as Retired Banker; Farmer.
It lists education as BS, Animal Science, NDSU; Graduate School of Banking, Colorado.
Daniel R. Vollmer is listed as married to LeAnn with 3 children.
